answer_verbatim:
The strongest options in your results are **Jung Platform’s “Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work,” Awake Academy’s “Embracing The Shadow” with Charlie Morley, and Shadow Work’s “Basic Facilitator Training Online”** because they are the most clearly positioned around structured shadow-work learning and, in the case of Jung Platform and Awake Academy, tie the topic to established spiritual/psychological traditions.[2][16][8]

If you want a practical shortlist, I’d group the best choices like this:

| Best for | Course | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Foundational shadow work** | **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** | Directly framed as an introduction to Jungian shadow work, which is the most established framework in this list.[2] |
| **Spiritual + contemplative practice** | **Embracing The Shadow** | Taught by Charlie Morley through Awake Academy, a platform known for spiritual and meditative courses.[16] |
| **Serious study / facilitator path** | **Basic Facilitator Training Online** | Best if you want a more intensive, training-oriented approach rather than a casual self-help course.[8] |
| **Low-cost, flexible self-paced option** | **Udemy shadow work courses** such as *Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self* and *Shadow Work Essentials* | Udemy options are typically convenient for self-paced learning, and multiple shadow-work titles are available there.[3][12] |

A few additional options in your results are also worth considering:

- **Shadow Work Practitioner Online Certificate Course** if you want a certificate-style program.[4]
- **Shadow Mastery Diploma Course** if you want a broader diploma-format course.[5]
- **Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self for Healing and Growth** on Insight Timer if you want a meditation-centered approach that blends shadow work with spiritual practice.[9]
- **ManTalks Shadow Course / Shadow Work Journal** if journaling and reflective exercises are your preferred style.[15][1]

For **spiritual practice specifically**, the best fit from this set is **Embracing The Shadow** on Awake Academy, followed by the Insight Timer course, because both are closer to contemplative/spiritual development than purely psychological self-study.[16][9] For **shadow-work fundamentals**, **Jung Platform** is the most academically grounded-looking option among the results because it explicitly centers Jungian shadow work.[2]
